messages:
zoe: Heads-up: us-east dedicated-pool-7 saw a big tail-latency blip at 06:10 UTC. GPUs look healthy but control-plane connections started failing intermittently and clients retried -> latency spike.

carlos: any network counters?

zoe: SNAT metrics show ephemeral_port_usage peaked at 65535 on nat-7 and we hit mapping table limits. lots of short-lived TCP 4-tuples from health-checks and preconnects.

tara: that smells like fanout + no connection reuse. Which tenant rollout was active?

zoe: tenant Z started a rollout that spins 1s health-checks from 10k agents around 06:07. quick snippet from gotcp logs:
```
[06:07:12] open conn -> 10.1.2.3:443 ephemeral=42112
[06:07:12] close conn after 0.8s
```

carlos: short lived connections = massive fn of ephemeral ports. NAT mapping churn + driver overhead -> RSTs and TCP_RETRY spikes.

infra-bot: alert: nat-7 ephemeral_port_exhaustion at 2025-09-04T06:10:05Z. ticket created: #6421.

tara: quick mitigation: 1) divert egress from dedicated-pool-7 to nat-9/nat-10, 2) soft throttle tenant Z health-check fanout to 2%, 3) add 2 nat instances to pool.

net-bot: route update applied: us-east/dedicated-pool-7 -> nat-9,nat-10 (change id: route-6421).

carlos: applying override: `curl -XPOST https://ops/overrides -d '{"tenant":"Z","healthcheck_fanout_pct":2,"ttl":"1h"}'`

infra-bot: override accepted (ov-6421a). autoscale: adding nat-9,nat-10 instances.

zoe: After routing and override, ephemeral_port_usage dropped to ~11k and connection reuse improved. 95p tail down from 250ms -> 42ms in ~6m.

tara: followups: 1) platform: require long-lived pooled connections for health-check libs (feature flag + canary), 2) infra: per-tenant ephemeral-port accounting + soft quotas, 3) network: autoscale nat pool at 70% port usage and prefer distributed SNAT across racks.

carlos: I'll open infra ticket for per-tenant accounting and a small dashboard for port telemetry. tara pls file a PR for connection pooling canary.

infra-bot: note: incident tag `snat-port-thundering` created. escalate if recurrence within 24h.

zoe: cost note: spinning two small nat instances ~ $0.6/hr. dev work estimate: pooling PR + tests ~ 1 day, infra + autoscale ~ 1.5 days.

carlos: 15m check-in: metrics stable. removing kinetic overrides at 07:25 but keeping tickets open for follow-up. :thumbsup:
file_note: realistic slack thread about SNAT ephemeral port exhaustion caused by health-check fanout and mitigations
